title: Add reusable CI workflows for new runtimes
context: Kotlin, Terraform, CDK, Elixir, Zig, and Swift packages currently use self-contained CI workflows. Reusable workflows in workflow-event should own the shared setup and checks.

spec.summary: Add reusable CI workflows for the new language and infrastructure runtimes, then point consumers at them.
spec.expected_outcome: Every new package calls a workflow-event reusable workflow instead of duplicating setup.
acceptance_criteria: Java/Kotlin, Terraform, Elixir, Zig, and Swift have reusable workflows or a documented shared container path
CDK uses the shared Node workflow where possible
Consumers pin the new workflow tag
Self-contained setup is removed or documented as a temporary exception
